2020-218.sentence: Her 'don't know' is delirium, not a failed integrity-versus-despair conversation, so you do not ask her to finish Erikson's last task on the MRI consent form. Look first for an advance directive—the written remnant of a time when she could still choose how this ending would go.

2020-219.sentence: Low desire here is not a moral failure or leftover SSRI residue; falling testosterone is the physiology that withdraws the drive that used to make wanting feel possible. Treat the hormone story as the symptom's job: it is telling you the engine is down, not that she has given up on intimacy.

2020-220.sentence: When his sleep collapses mid-sentence, you can feel recruited into the all-night sentry—countertransference as the urge to stay hypervigilant because his orexin neurons in the lateral hypothalamic nuclei no longer hold the wake line. Use that pull as data: you are being asked to be the missing hypocretin system, not to scold him for 'giving up.

2020-221.sentence: Mandatory minimums for drug offenses were a national superego move: conscience outsourced to statute so we could punish without thinking. The sanctioned gap is that we then called the resulting jail census a psychiatry problem instead of a sentencing one.

2020-222.sentence: Late life does not restore childhood Stage-4 sleep; REM shrinks, arousals rise, and the old capacity for long dream-rich nights has quietly left. Do not treat that developmental loss as insomnia you must hypnotic away before you have named what aging actually changed.

2020-223.sentence: Verapamil as prevention does something the abortives never do: it lengthens the stretch of ordinary life between attacks, so the man is not organizing his week around the next retro-orbital blast. Cluster headache is already a body that seizes the clock; a calcium-channel blocker that actually cuts cluster frequency gives him a mind that can plan instead of wait.

2020-224.sentence: Depressive disorders topping DALYs is the population version of nameless dread: a huge load of unmetabolized misery that never quite becomes a thinkable request for care. Naming depression as the largest psychiatric disability burden is containment at scale—it turns a raw pile of years-lost into something a department can actually plan around.

2020-225.sentence: Inter-rater reliability—scores that stay similar when different people administer the same scale—is the clinic’s version of a stable mirror: the patient is not a different person just because the rater changed. Without that sameness, measurement-based care cannot shore up self-esteem; the number feels like a verdict, not a shared picture of how they are doing.

2020-226.sentence: Bright light therapy for seasonal affective disorder meets a winter drive toward sleep and carbohydrate without a pill-as-prohibition. The light does not argue with the wish to hibernate; it resets the circadian clock so the wish and the daytime demand stop colliding every November.

2020-227.sentence: An ACA infarct in the medial motor homunculus shows up as leg weakness, not as a story the patient can tell about the stroke. What cannot be represented as ‘I had a clot in the parasagittal cortex’ is repeated in the body as a limp the dyad now has to walk around.

2020-228.sentence: A delusion of reference (the TV is sending messages meant just for him) is already a mind that cannot use much uncovering; you name the symptom and stay supportive. Digging for ‘why the news anchor’ usually tightens the idea rather than loosening it.

2020-229.sentence: The suprachiasmatic nucleus is the master pacemaker; a night-shift nurse and a delayed-sleep-phase teen are both fighting a clock, not a character flaw. You cannot talk that nucleus into an earlier bedtime any more than you can rush a developmental stage—light and schedule move it, lectures do not.

2020-230.sentence: ACTH, LH, FSH, and β-endorphin sit in vesicles until a pulse lets them go; DHEA is a steroid that diffuses as soon as it is made. That is a drive that leaks rather than a wish you can hold—once the adrenal synthesizes DHEA, the collision is already in the bloodstream, not waiting in storage for a more polite release.

2020-231.sentence: Shenjing shuairuo is the culture-bound heir of neurasthenia: the self feels emptied of vitality—fatigue, headache, fog—not seized by a discrete Western disease. Mirroring that collapse as real depletion of cohesion protects self-esteem better than forcing a depression label the patient hears as an insult to competence.

2020-232.sentence: Collaborative care dumps raw dread into you—suicidal patients you never met—and a written behavioral-health emergency policy is containment: turning nameless panic into a thinkable plan. Without those policies the team evacuates anxiety into curbside chats and assumed supervision instead of a procedure that can actually hold a crisis.

2020-233.sentence: By late school age (about 10), especially in vulnerable boys, the peer group—not the parent—first becomes the main mediator of aggression. That parental monopoly has a time limit you cannot rush or extend with preschool rules; the ending is the developmental work.

2020-234.sentence: Carbohydrate-deficient transferrin is the most specific lab for heavy drinking when AST, GGT, and the rest stay noisy. Offering the CDT is a trial comment in numbers: if he can see his own part in it, you have insight; if he only litigates lipase and bilirubin, he is not using his mind on the alcohol.

2020-235.sentence: Collaborative care works only if you hold the frame: you advise the primary-care team and the care manager’s PHQ-9 registry; you do not quietly become the treating psychiatrist for every unimproved patient. The ethical limit is who owns the patient—when you start seeing “just this one” yourself, you have stepped out of the consult role and collapsed the team.

2020-236.sentence: Ziprasidone only absorbs if it arrives with at least 500 calories, so the meal is part of the prescription, not a courtesy tip. The pill can feel like a demand—“eat this much or I fail you”—and naming that demand out loud keeps the food from becoming a silent power struggle.

2020-237.sentence: The magnetic gait of NPH (normal-pressure hydrocephalus) looks like the feet are glued down, and families often treat that as mere aging rather than a reversible triad with incontinence and memory loss. That is denial: they push the stuck walk out of awareness so they do not have to face a brain that can be shunted—or a decline that cannot.

2020-238.sentence: MHPAEA (Mental Health Parity and Addiction Equity Act) is the repair: it forbids the insurer from giving psych five days while medicine gets a longer stay. The plan has projected the “bad, endless” illness into psychiatry and then starved it; invoking parity puts the damage back where it belongs and asks for equal limits.

2020-239.sentence: REM is not a quiet cultural nap: heart rate rises, blood pressure swings, and the body is atonic while the brain runs hot. If you only picture REM as “dreamy and still,” you are using a tidy story of rest that erases the actual physiology—same move as treating a patient’s inner life as calmer than the tracing shows.

2020-240.sentence: Smith–Magenis (17p11.2) walks in with a coarsening broad face, hoarse deep voice, and often ferocious self-injury, and you can feel recruited to become the one who finally “controls” the body. That countertransference is the pull to manage the syndrome instead of staying the consultant who names the deletion and the self-harm risk.

2020-241.sentence: A “negative” head CT can function like a rigid conscience: you ordered the scan, so you feel licensed to stop worrying. Beam-hardening artifact in the posterior fossa is the sanctioned gap—the brainstem and cerebellum stay poorly seen while the report soothes you.

2020-242.sentence: The wish is the surge: ventral tegmental area dopamine hitting the nucleus accumbens. The prohibition is the next morning’s vow, and the mesolimbic loop keeps firing the wish past the no, so gambling and opioids repeat as the same collision.

2020-243.sentence: Vagal nerve stimulator pulses arrive in the neck and chest before they become a story—hoarseness, cough, cyclic dyspnea. What cannot be remembered as “the implant just fired” is lived in the body as sudden air hunger.

2020-244.sentence: That last session dumped the ending into the room instead of holding it until it could be thought. The lawsuit is leftover nameless dread looking for a container; malpractice law only answers if an appreciably bad outcome made the harm thinkable.

2020-245.sentence: Rationalization is a self-esteem patch: the student cannot bear “I am not yet a surgeon.” Blaming the attending and the techs restores a competent self by making the injury come from outside.

2020-246.sentence: Psychological mindedness here is seeing your own delay: vertigo, confusion, and restricted lateral gaze after bariatric surgery are Wernicke until proven otherwise. Give thiamine now; waiting for a prettier explanation is refusing to own the part you can still treat.

2020-247.sentence: Catatonia is a freeze that will not be hurried. The lorazepam challenge is a time-limited test: you give a benzodiazepine and wait for speech and movement to return, instead of forcing the mute, posturing patient with an antipsychotic.

2020-248.sentence: A pill can be a feed, not only a chemical. SSRIs, exercise, and enriched environments matter because adult neurogenesis still happens in the hippocampal dentate gyrus, so the medicine is also a bid to grow new cells where memory is built.

2020-249.sentence: Someone has to hold the brake. Purkinje cells are the only output of cerebellar cortex, and they release GABA onto the deep nuclei—inhibition as the frame that keeps movement from flying past the mark.

2020-250.sentence: Reading a face is a developmental achievement, not a courtesy. Oxytocin is the hormone that most clearly supports that social wiring; if it never quite arrived, the child misses expression and emotion even when the face is right in front of them.

2020-251.sentence: Secure attachment is protest plus repair, not stoicism. In the Strange Situation the 14-month-old gets upset when mother leaves and calms when she returns—the relationship can hold the protest without collapse.

2020-252.sentence: Late life asks for integrity versus despair: can this person still make meaning of what was lost. Greater spirituality tracks with higher resilience in community-dwelling older adults because prayer and congregation are one way the last stage stays livable.

2020-253.sentence: The hyperactive orbitofrontal–basal-ganglia–thalamus loop is the checking itself: it keeps sending “not done” until the ritual briefly quiets the circuit. The contamination fear is not noise on top of OCD; it is the mind’s attempt to bind uncertainty by running that cortico-striato-thalamo-cortical loop again.

2020-254.sentence: The uncinate fasciculus is the hook from orbitofrontal cortex into anterior temporal lobe—the white-matter path that lets judgment sit with feeling instead of splitting them. When that tract works, concern and the wish to repair can reach the same object that once felt only dangerous.

2020-255.sentence: Task-switching in healthy aging fails first at attention, not memory: the spotlight cannot move as fast even when the facts are still there. That is late-life development, not dementia—the same kitchen, two tasks, a slower gate on what gets held in mind at once.

2020-256.sentence: Quetiapine is FDA-approved antidepressant augmentation when an SSRI has already done what uncovering-plus-serotonin can do. Use it as support, not as a prompt to interpret harder: this ego still needs scaffolding more than another hour of meaning-making.

2020-257.sentence: NMDA is the coincidence detector for long-term potentiation: both sides of the synapse must fire together or the connection does not strengthen. Holding a good and a bad version of the same person works the same way—without that joint firing, the link never consolidates.

2020-258.sentence: Mirtazapine blocks 5-HT3, so the gut does not reject the pill the way many SSRIs make it reject closeness. The patient can keep the drug as a regulating other—sleep, appetite, presence—instead of separating from treatment through nausea.

2020-259.sentence: Justice is the two of you turning a seminar into a fairness contest: if stimulants sharpen ADHD kids and healthy controls alike, then every child is owed the same pill. The interpersonal trap is treating enhancement as a shared right you owe each other, instead of noticing that equal access is not the same as the same clinical need.

2020-260.sentence: Label D is the habenula, the tiny epithalamic disappointment switch that fires when the expected reward does not show up. Think of it as the brain saying the deal fell through, so the structure is worth finding because it is hardware for dashed hope, not just another unlabeled blob.

2020-261.sentence: DNA methylation can silence a gene after childhood trauma without changing the letter sequence, so the insult lives as a mute switch rather than a mutation. That is how an old injury still shapes depression risk decades later: the code is intact, but the cell has learned to stay quiet.

2020-262.sentence: Limit setting in toddlerhood is the parent surviving the tantrum so the child learns the 'no' does not destroy either of you. That is the start of depressive concern, Klein's term for caring that you hurt someone you still need, and then wanting to repair.

2020-263.sentence: After a left MCA stroke with nonfluent Broca aphasia, speech and repetition fail, but comprehension often holds, so the patient can still close their eyes when you ask. Relatedness can survive when output is rubble: they can still take you in even if they cannot send a fluent sentence back.

2020-264.sentence: The centromedial nuclei of the amygdala are the output station that dumps fear into brainstem and hypothalamus, so the body runs panic before any interpretation arrives. Early technique is support, not uncovering: you cannot talk someone out of a viscera that has already been launched.

2020-265.sentence: Universalization is a two-person (really many-person) event: the withdrawn member does not suddenly invent the idea of not being alone; another patient has to say the same shame out loud. Cohesion is the later glue of the group; this moment is the shared naming that lets the pair stop treating hospitalization as a private stain.

2020-266.sentence: A Joint Commission survey is a scheduled proximity check: the hospital has to show it can be a secure base—charts, seclusion/restraint, suicide-risk notes—or the inspecting other will protest with findings. Residents often feel the survey as abandonment threat; the adult task is to use the visit to regulate the unit, not to hide from it.

2020-267.sentence: Lower educational level tracks with weaker ego tools for living with unexplained pain: less language, fewer options, thinner affect tolerance when the body keeps ringing the alarm. Employment and higher SES usually mean more coping room; here the symptom persists because there is less ego to metabolize it.

2020-268.sentence: Anandamide is the endogenous ligand with the highest affinity for CB-1; when cannabis floods that receptor, the mind is evacuating nameless dread instead of containing it. Withdrawal is the opposite: the container is empty, and raw agitation returns because nothing is holding the feeling long enough to think it.

2020-269.sentence: Tertiary prevention here is a selfobject move: vocational rehab offers competence and a usable ideal of a working self after schizophrenia has already damaged function. You are not preventing the illness; you are restoring a mirror that says this person can still do something that matters.

2020-270.sentence: Somatic symptom disorder is not “unexplained tests”; it is excessive behavior around the headache, belly pain, and fatigue—checking, returning, insisting something is missed. Developmentally, the capacity to keep a bodily worry inside and wait never quite arrived, so the ED becomes the only place the anxiety can live.

2020-271.sentence: When bipolar illness breaks as postpartum psychosis, the conscience that should protect the infant can go offline or turn cruel. Treat the bipolar diathesis first: a hole in the maternal superego is an emergency, not a character flaw you interpret on call.

2020-272.sentence: High expressed emotion is criticism and hostility that recruits you to join the chorus or to become the only safe parent. If you start scolding the patient or resenting the family, you are already in the transference the schizophrenia keeps relapsing inside.

2020-273.sentence: A confidence interval is the honest frame around a trial result: how far this sample’s antidepressant effect can stretch toward your unit. Skip it and you treat a point estimate like a commandment instead of a range you still have to think about.

2020-274.sentence: Serotonin is the precursor the pineal converts into melatonin, so mood chemistry and the night clock share a pipeline. Seasonal depression and delayed sleep phase are clock problems: miss that serotonin-to-melatonin handoff and the day never quite arrives.

2020-275.sentence: Salivation, chewing, and a choking sensation are the frontal operculum speaking in the mouth’s own circuit. Localize there before you call it panic or conversion; the seizure is using the swallowing stage, not a metaphor.

2020-276.sentence: Winnicott’s good-enough parent is attuned enough that the infant can feel their own drives—Erikson’s first job of basic trust versus mistrust. Perfect rescue is not the goal; reliable-enough response lets the baby discover “I want” without drowning in need.

2020-277.sentence: A family history of bipolar disorder is doing two jobs at once: it marks real genetic risk, and it can make you treat every depressive episode as a fuse about to light. Hold both facts—the commonest illness in those relatives is still major depressive disorder, so you watch for mania without turning the pedigree into a prophecy.

2020-278.sentence: Ask whether she can see the binge as her part in a feeling she cannot name, not just as a food problem. A trial comment—“the urge hits when the feeling gets too big”—tests psychological mindedness and is why adapted DBT has evidence in eating disorders.

2020-279.sentence: You hold the medical frame: fixation-dependent gaze-evoked nystagmus is cerebellar until proven otherwise, not a “psychogenic” blur. Confidentiality and kindness do not replace sending him for a cerebellar workup when the finding only appears when he is asked to fixate.

2020-280.sentence: The didactic is already an enactment: two people repeating the old fight over who owns the child’s mind instead of naming the history. Melanie Klein, not Anna Freud or Mahler, is the principal architect of object relations—say her name so the pair can study the theory rather than restage the schoolyard.

2020-281.sentence: The “surgeon’s aura” is magical thinking doing defensive work: it keeps the other person dangerous-but-distant so ordinary closeness never has to be risked. That pattern, plus lifelong oddness mom confirms, is schizotypal, not schizoid withdrawal or borderline storm.

2020-282.sentence: Pulsatile GnRH from the infundibular nucleus starts a body change the child’s ego—her capacity to feel, wait, and stay real—has to digest. Early thelarche is not only endocrine; it asks whether she can tolerate a new sexual body without flooding or shutting down.

2020-283.sentence: The bottle is a portable piece of you: it keeps the tie alive between visits so she does not have to feel dropped. That is a kind of dissociation—a vertical split—she leaves the empty waiting without leaving the chair, because the object still says the doctor exists.

2020-284.sentence: Ask whether they can see their own part in the distress: the mismatch hurts, and so does the wish that the body, the parent, or you would settle the identity for them. A trial comment—naming the pain without arguing the label—tests if they can use insight rather than only demand a verdict.

2020-285.sentence: The triple screen (AFP, estriol, and hCG) is a number that arrives before anyone is ready; it cannot be rushed into certainty. Your job at the limit is to hold the wait: risk is not a diagnosis, and the psyche needs time the lab does not give.

2020-286.sentence: The pill, the court, and you can all become feed, poison, or proof that he is still the beaten child who must now hit. Childhood abuse is the associated factor; treat the medication and the mandate as relationship, not as a chemical eraser of that history.

2020-287.sentence: Genomic imprinting means the same 15q gene speaks differently depending on which parent it came from—Prader-Willi versus Angelman—and you do not get to rewrite the parent of origin. The ethical frame is to report what the biology actually is, not what the family wishes the inheritance had been.

2020-288.sentence: Intellectual disability is the comorbidity that most often rides with autism; the wish to relate and the prohibition against how the mind can relate collide in the same child. The symptom (self-injury, mutism, the team’s urgency) often carries that collision, not a hidden second diagnosis you can wish away.

2020-289.sentence: Brain histamine is synthesized only in the hypothalamus, so an H1 blocker does not 'nudge' sleep — it cuts the one wake signal the rest of the brain cannot make. That is an unrepresented state: alertness is not remembered as a thought; when the hypothalamic factory goes quiet, the body just drops.

2020-290.sentence: Immediate alertness after the spell is the useful discriminator: an epileptic discharge usually leaves a postictal brain that cannot come back online, while PNES often ends with the person already oriented. In Kleinian terms that is a discharge of projective identification — the unbearable bit is put into the body-event, then the mind returns because nothing neuronal was actually knocked out.

2020-291.sentence: Supportive psychotherapy is the treatment that uses direct measures to ease symptoms and to keep self-esteem, ego functions, and adaptive skills working. A mind that decompensates when you probe cannot use uncovering yet; you lend structure so the ego can stay in the room.

2020-292.sentence: After high-quality verbal de-escalation fails, restraints belong to imminent assault: throwing at the nurse, punching security, bolting for the exit — not loud affect, threats without action, or a demand for a benzo. Technique here is not insight; it is a firm frame when words cannot hold the aggression.

2020-293.sentence: It is the rapidity of estrogen change in the menopausal transition that tracks new depression, not a simple low-estrogen trough. The relationship to the hormonal object goes unstable when the level swings fast: good and bad bodily states cannot be held in one piece.

2020-294.sentence: Transient global amnesia is a sudden failure of new encoding — two hours of 'Why am I here?' in an alert person who still knows who she is and can still move. The developmental capacity to lay down a next moment went offline; identity and motor self did not.

2020-295.sentence: The CGG triple-repeat in Fragile X does not just enlarge testes and ears; it can leave a mother holding a secret-feeling family story that her conscience, the inner critic that says she should have known, will try to police. Name the inheritance out loud so guilt does not fill the gap the FMR1 expansion actually occupies.

2020-296.sentence: The battlefield explosion is the unconditioned stimulus: it already made the body jump before any pairing, so the later shrill sound only borrows that alarm. Erikson’s identity-versus-role-confusion task is still open after deployment; the startle is the body arguing that the old soldier-self never got to finish becoming a civilian.

2020-297.sentence: STAR*D let patients choose switch versus augment, so the trial’s “meaning” is that agency itself is part of the antidepressant. When a colleague quotes STAR*D to push a drug, ask whether the patient is being offered that same choice or only the algorithm.

2020-298.sentence: Increased EEG slow-wave activity is the cortex going offline; calling it “just sundowning” is denial, the mind’s refusal to see what the tracing already shows. Slow waves do not negotiate; they ask you to treat the encephalopathy instead of arguing with the patient.

2020-299.sentence: Longer nocturnal awakenings in older adults are normal physiology, yet the request for zolpidem can become an enactment: the two of you repeat a rescue that treats aging as a failure to sleep through. Name the longer awakenings as expected before you and the clinic start acting like night itself is an emergency.

2020-300.sentence: Duloxetine, venlafaxine, and gabapentin can quiet diabetic neuropathic pain even when mood is intact, because the burning lives in unrepresented body states that never became a memory you can talk about. Treat the feet with those three before you hunt for a depression that is not there.

2021-1.sentence: Skipping HLA-B*1502 testing before carbamazepine in a Han Chinese patient is already an enactment: the team is living a known SJS/TEN script instead of naming the risk out loud. The gene check is the pause that keeps you from repeating harm in the body while you talk about mood stabilization.

2021-2.sentence: Long-term haloperidol without renegotiating the contract is a frame problem: the nigrostriatal D2 blockade keeps running after the original psychosis limit has gone slack. Tardive dyskinesia is the body collecting the unpaid fee for a treatment frame nobody is holding.

2021-3.sentence: Oxytocin is not just a hypothalamic peptide for osmoregulation and feeding; in the room it can feel like a proof-of-need pill for closeness. When a postpartum patient asks about the spray, she is asking whether a molecule can stand in for being held, not only whether it binds the receptor.

2021-4.sentence: An autosomal-dominant Huntington pedigree means the child never had a secure base that would stay intact; the attachment figure is already written into CAG-repeat decline. Separation protest shows up early as watching every generation for chorea, because proximity itself becomes a countdown.

2021-5.sentence: Smaller hippocampal volume in PTSD is not a solo memory glitch; the veteran and you have to co-hold a timeline his hippocampus will not keep. Each session is two people rebuilding sequence so the war does not keep arriving as if it is still happening.

2021-6.sentence: When oral donepezil makes the gut revolt, the family starts to leave the treatment without leaving the chair—that is a split: care continues in talk while the body is abandoned. The rivastigmine patch keeps acetylcholine in the skin so the person does not have to dissociate from the medicine to stop vomiting.

2021-7.sentence: Acupuncture can hold some of the pain so she does not have to fight every ache with willpower alone; that is affect tolerance, the ego’s capacity to stay with feeling without flooding or shutting down. You still name the evidence: it is strongest for pain management, not for her depression, so reality testing stays intact while she tries a real adjunct.

2021-8.sentence: An adult who can stay awake and oriented is generating beta: low-amplitude, fast waves that mark an organized, eyes-open mind. Developmentally that is the EEG of a working cortex, not the slow delta of deep sleep or the drowsy theta of a mind slipping out of contact.

2021-9.sentence: The PHQ-9 and GAD-7 in the waiting room are part of the frame: they collect scores before you sit down so the hour is not spent hunting checklists. That efficiency is not a shortcut around the person; it buys time to hear what the numbers cannot say.

2021-10.sentence: Grandiosity and no sleep can look like a story you could interpret; DSM-5 still requires the body to show increased activity or energy before you call it mania. What cannot be put into words often arrives as motor drive first, so you diagnose the gate criterion, then listen to what the surge is carrying.

2021-11.sentence: Fatigue plus dark skin and buccal mucosa will recruit you as the depression doctor; that pull is countertransference, the feeling that you should stay in the mood story. Order the ACTH stimulation test anyway, because primary adrenal failure is asking you to be the one who looks at the body, not only the affect.

2021-12.sentence: Naloxone in the film is a built-in conscience: swallowed or injected, it blocks the high and punishes the shortcut. Taken under the tongue as prescribed, it stays quiet, so the combination cuts abuse potential without turning every dose into a lecture.

2021-13.sentence: FKBP5 is the chaperone that sets how tightly the glucocorticoid receptor listens to cortisol, so early abuse can lock the HPA axis in a high-alarm setting before the child’s self-soothing functions have even come online. The later depression is not just a memory of harm; it is a stress-regulation capacity that never quite arrived, because the gene that should have damped the alarm was turned up instead.

2021-14.sentence: Unrestricted EHR access is a limit on the fantasy that psychiatry can stay a sealed room; the outcome that actually argues for it is lower readmission when medicine can see the notes. Ending the wall is not a betrayal of the patient so much as a refusal to rush a discharge that the rest of the hospital cannot think about.

2021-15.sentence: Those ventricles have turned pressure into space the cortex cannot use, and gait apraxia is the body evacuating a step it can no longer hold as a plan. You contain the family’s nameless dread—the fear that “he is just getting old”—by naming NPH: wet, wobbly, and wacky, ordinary opening pressure, treatable if you think it.

2021-16.sentence: The hospital doors have become a stand-in for the infusion, so nausea arrives as a conditioned response before any drug is given—the self loses a piece of competence it used to take for granted. Mirroring that loss (“your body learned the building means poison”) restores a bit of idealizable control: the pairing can be unlearned, not just endured.

2021-17.sentence: After deliberate self-harm, male gender is the marker that most raises completed suicide in the next year—the aggressive drive is less likely to stay aimed at the skin and more likely to finish the act. The collision is a death wish meeting a thinner prohibition against dying, so the follow-up has to be denser, not more polite.

2021-18.sentence: Cannabis is the substance most likely to convert an induced psychosis into schizophrenia or bipolar, as if the drug has glued a bad object to the mind and the mind cannot spit it out once the high is gone. The family wants a one-time event; you hold both the clearing with abstinence and the higher conversion risk without splitting them into “just weed” versus “he is already lost.”

2021-19.sentence: Ketamine’s glutamate (NMDA) hit is a supportive intervention: it lifts mood without asking this treatment-resistant ego to wait weeks while serotonin slowly reorganizes. Match technique to capacity—use a fast glutamatergic reset when the patient cannot yet use the slow, uncovering timeline of an SSRI.

2021-20.sentence: Adult neurogenesis along the lateral ventricle (subventricular zone) is the brain’s version of Kleinian repair: damage is not only to be evacuated, it can be remade. That is depressive-position hope, not a manic denial that nothing was lost.

2021-21.sentence: Intentional falsification with no disability check or drug payoff means the symptom’s job is to secure the sick role itself. The hidden insulin is not a con for cash; it is a desperate way to stay a patient when ordinary asking for care has failed.

2021-22.sentence: A school-age (latency) child can use rule-talk and fairness, not an uncovering hunt for the wish behind the tattling. Stay with who broke the rule; do not push free-associative depth this ego has not yet got.

2021-23.sentence: Behavioral activation puts a usable good object back in the week—scheduled pleasure, mastery, and a person to tell it to—when depression has collapsed inner company into one bad lump. Sharing the small tasks with you is how good and withdrawn get held in the same relationship instead of split.

2021-24.sentence: The dorsal periaqueductal gray is a very early capacity: freeze, flee, and fight arrive before words or an observing ego. Panic that fires from there is not a late conflict you interpret first; it is a brainstem layer that never quite got a cortex to contain it.

2021-25.sentence: An enrichment design with a placebo lead-in is a sanctioned moral cut: the protocol first excludes people whose hope already moved the needle, then reports a cleaner effect size with a cleaner conscience. Name the method when you read it—selecting placebo non-responders shrinks the placebo rate and keeps the most drug-sensitive remainder, not a more honest sample of everyone who walks in.

2021-26.sentence: This group sits on intimacy versus isolation: can the person stay in a room with others without dissolving or fleeing, not can they excavate a personality. Aim at social skills—turn-taking, greeting, staying—because insight, empathy work, and cognitive challenge ask for a later Erikson task this mind cannot yet use.

2021-27.sentence: The old unmodified seizure meant punishment on film: a body thrown into a public convulsion. Brief general anesthesia plus succinylcholine—a depolarizing paralytic—stripped that theater so ECT could mean a controlled treatment instead of a fracture-risk assault.

2021-28.sentence: The wish is a gene test that names fate; the prohibition is that thousands of common variants cannot declare disease or replace a family history. A polygenic risk score is the compromise: it can nudge prognosis talk after first-episode psychosis, not screen autism or homogenize ethnicity.
